body.statement: For every fixed categorical double-triangular graph \(\Gamma\) and latent DAG \(\Lambda\), \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\) is a rational function on \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\) with strictly positive denominators and a nonzero polynomial numerator \(N_{\mathrm{DT}}\). The diagonal-dominant family in Definition 5 belongs to \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\) and has \(d_{a,k,u}=\eta_{a,k,u}^{q-1}\). Hence \(\{\theta\in\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}:\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}(\theta)\neq0\}\) is nonempty, relatively open and dense, and its complement has Lebesgue measure zero in the affine product of simplex interiors.
body.justification: An explicit interior family certifies that generic nonvanishing is substantive rather than an unsupported algebraic slogan.
body.gap: Lee and Gu (2026, Appendix G) note a categorical determinant obstruction but do not exhibit a nonzero polynomial witness for every fixed double-triangular graph or derive relative openness and density.
body.consumer: Designers may perturb a positive item bank away from the certificate boundary without changing its graph.
